formulaCatalogue.definition: For positive case i, eligible grade-2 groups from non-empty L_i represented in the first five final selected-evidence items T_i^5 divided by |L_i|.
1/rank_i when the first eligible grade-2 item is at rank 1..5; otherwise 0.
Groups from L_i present in the first five raw hits divided by |L_i|.
Required facts with at least one selected grade-2 association divided by all required facts for the case.
Ranks 1..5 with an eligible grade-2 association divided by 5; absent ranks contribute zero.
sum for r=1..5 of (2^grade_r - 1) / log2(r + 1).
DCG@5 / IDCG@5; zero IDCG produces nDCG=0 only in the separate negative denominator.
Simple arithmetic mean over positive cases.
Simple arithmetic mean over positive cases in that stratum.
Mean across variants within each semanticCaseGroupId, then simple mean across groups.
Planned comparisons with an ordered digest identical to the reference divided by all planned comparisons.
Finite scores in raw hits for quality cases divided by all scores in those raw hits.
Quality cases ending in Succeeded or NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all frozen quality cases.
Judged items in final top-five sequences divided by all items in those sequences.
Materialised mandatory contract cells divided by 38.
Fixtures with exact outcome and assertions divided by 38.
Materialised boundary cells divided by 10.
Adversarial cases returning at least one Ineligible item divided by all adversarial cases.
Negative cases returning NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all negative cases.
Positive cases returning NoSelectedEvidenceUnderPolicy divided by all positive cases.
score - 0.25.
For p50, p95, and p99, the ordered value at position ceiling(p*n), using a one-based index.
A zero denominator for a hard rate or mandatory stratum is NOT_EVALUABLE and fails the gate.
Positive technical failure contributes zero to Recall and MRR and fails ExecutionCompleteness; negative technical failure never counts as correct empty selection.

rules.definition: Each negative subtype has at least 25 cases.
Each of pt-BR and en-GB has at least 25 negative cases.
Each active database by questionLanguage has at least 2 positive cases and 1 negative case.
Each active document by questionLanguage has at least 1 positive case.
Each questionLanguage crossed with each exact contentLanguage has at least 25 positive cases.
Each active document format has at least 25 positive cases.
Each (SourceTrustClass, SourceAdapterId, OfficialSourceRegistrationIdOrLocalSentinel) stratum has at least 25 positive cases.

quotaPolicy.comparativePilotBoundary: Meeting the frozen base quotas permits only COMPARATIVE_PILOT.
quotaPolicy.representativeClaimBoundary: Representative product homologation additionally requires at least 30 positives per active database and per source stratum, with both questionLanguages represented; every mandatory stratum below 30 is UNDERPOWERED and blocks the claim.

versioningPolicy.successorRequirement: any later change requires a new evaluationDesignContractRevision

trackedEvidenceBoundary: Full questions, qrels, vectors, pools, and raw results stay outside Git.
Only sanitised IDs, digests, counts, score bits, times, and outcomes may enter tracked evidence.
No secret, real hostname, user path, full passage, or inline vector is permitted.
Restricted inputs remain immutable while referenced; physical deletion requires later authority and a cleanup plan.

stopConditions: Baseline branch, commit, clean tree, prompt corpus version, or protected OpenAPI identity diverges.
A concurrent change or a path outside the closed inventory appears.
The revision namespace already exists with different content.
Code, tests, OpenAPI, public contracts, product schemas, migrations, dependencies, or lockfiles would need to change.
A product document, product case, qrel, question, vector, index generation, observed result, or scored value would enter this revision.
An existing synthetic revision would need to be altered, copied, or promoted.
retrieval-v2, the numerical semantics, or the /2 descriptor cannot be preserved.
An accepted formula, threshold, quota, denominator, or rule would need to change.
A schema, digest, inventory, count, or authorised check fails.
Provider, credential, network, runtime, process, listener, database, generation, or external action becomes necessary.
Sensitive content, a secret, a real hostname, or a personal path would enter an artefact.
negativeScope: No query vector, embedding, or generation.
No executable fixture, code, test, or harness.
No executable scorer, result, run, or observed metric.
No real corpus or historical synthetic revision change.
No OpenAPI v1 or v2, public contract, or C# or TypeScript type change.
No persistence schema, migration, dependency, or lockfile change.
No provider, credential, network, paid call, or external source.
No runtime preflight, process, listener, or database engine action.
No build, executable test, eng/ci.ps1, or Automatic Quality Gate.
No Human Gate or lifecycle change.
No push, pull request, merge, publication, release, or deployment.
